name: live_fast_travel
description: Fast travel is free, voted or locked by the policy row. Both peers start outdoors in Goodsprings (cell 000DAEBB, WastelandNV), an exterior cell that allows fast travel. Free: with no tether the guest travels to Sloan (000E62DF) at 3 s; the host grants the trip at once and only the guest moves. Voted: at 8 s the host starts a tether at the Goodsprings marker, so at 10 s the host's trip to the Goodsprings Cemetery (001088F6) opens a party vote; the guest votes yes at 12 s and both peers travel. The host ends the tether at 14 s. Locked: at 16 s the host opens the cinematic of FortEquipmentConfiscationQuest (00164762), a policy row with fast_travel_lock. At 18 s the guest and at 20 s the host ask to travel to Primm (000CDF46): the host refuses both trips, so both peers stay at the cemetery. Each peer carries out an allowed trip as the viewer's coop_live::intents::travel does (world::map::travel) and counts it in live.travels.
